_about: Wool and linen colors sampled from the Bayeux tapestry photos in ctc-journal/img/look/ref/ by sample.html (seeded k-means over all eight photos, then named patches). Each entry gives the photo and pixel it came from. 'kmeans' means a cluster center over all photos. ref01 is the evenly lit photo the linen comes from; ref02-06 are darker museum scans whose thread colors read correctly on that linen.

linen._src: mid: kmeans cluster (sample ref01 922,278); light: kmeans cluster (ref01 1114,470); dark: ref01 760,800 20th percentile #cfc3b5 darkened toward the ref03 linen #b8aea4

crease._src: shadow: kmeans cluster dark quantile (ref02 1354,106); deep: ref06 linen 1300,420 dark #afa59b less 5%; light: kmeans cluster (ref08 758,173)

terracotta._src: light ref06 420,800 median; mid between ref04 1380,700 (#7e5746) and kmeans thread #876a56; dark ref03 300,1140 20th pct

rule._src: ref03 300,1140 (the red-brown border rule and column stripes); dark toward kmeans #582f1f

buff._src: light ref01 520,650 80th pct; mid kmeans thread #c7ad95; dark kmeans thread #a8917e

ochre._src: mid ref08 750,800; light ref01 175,760 80th pct; dark ref01 520,650 20th pct; mid slightly desaturated

olive._src: ref04 720,700 (the green altar cloth); dark toward ref01 1250,700 #594d37

sage._src: mid kmeans thread #82807b (ref06 1210,1238); dark kmeans thread #69625a; light kmeans #9e9083 cooled

bluegreen._src: ref08 230,700 (shield) 80th pct #335e70; the saturated photo, so mid is its light value; desaturated 35% toward slate #51524b (ref08 is an oversaturated photo)
